g.title: alerts
g.text: Unique index treats null grid_cell_id values as equal

g.title: processed_frames
g.text: UQ*: output_asset_id is unique when not null

g.title: legend
g.text: PK = primary key; FK = foreign key; UQ = unique. Types are PostgreSQL types.
Double bar = exactly one; circle + bar = zero or one; circle + crow foot = zero or many.
Numeric labels give parent : child cardinality, not the number of rows currently stored.
All 11 tables, 105 columns and 13 foreign keys are shown. Defaults and CHECK rules remain in SQL.
A nullable grid reference supports frame-level records; scope checks still constrain current alerts.
